summary: Kadam was taken into custody late Monday by the Talegaon MIDC Police Station for investigation into the incident at the company's factory premises in Talegaon, Pune, on June 9, 2026, the company said.

title: Small-cap mutual funds: Should you pick funds with high index overlap? What one-year returns show
summary: Small-cap mutual funds with higher benchmark overlap did not necessarily deliver better returns. Value Research data shows one-year returns ranging from -0.1% to 29.1% across 10 schemes, highlighting why investors should look beyond portfolio overlap when choosing funds.

title: Bought a  ₹50 lakh LIC policy on  ₹4.81 lakh income? Why ITAT rejected the woman’s claim and upheld the tax addition
summary: A woman who declared  ₹4.81 lakh income invested  ₹50 lakh in an LIC policy, claiming the money came from her late husband’s HUF. ITAT rejected her explanation for lack of evidence and upheld the  ₹50 lakh addition as unexplained investment.

title: CBDT notifies Form 173A for government securities: New tax exemption rules for eligible foreign investors
summary: CBDT has notified Form 173A for eligible foreign institutional investors and the Bank for International Settlements claiming tax exemption on government securities. The form requires disclosures on holdings, interest income and capital gains.

title: Indian equities vs gold vs US stocks: Which asset class delivered the highest returns in 2026 so far?
summary: Indian equities fell 6.81% in 2026 so far through September, while US stocks gained 12.75% and gold rose 11.56%, according to Edelweiss Mutual Fund research. Short-term bonds returned 3.57%, while silver and Chinese equities posted losses.

title: One family brand, two heirs: how can you avoid trademark disputes?
summary: A family trademark is not a separate legal category under India’s trade mark law. For business owners planning succession, the key is to clarify ownership and usage rights before disputes arise.

title: Emergency fund: Earn  ₹1 lakh a month? Here’s how much you should save for 6, 9 or 12 months, experts explain
summary: An emergency fund should cover six, nine or 12 months of essential expenses, depending on job security, family responsibilities and income stability. Home loan EMIs, insurance premiums and school fees should be factored into the savings target.
